cards.title: Clinician User Story
items: Clinician registers new patient with pre-operative PSA and biopsy Gleason staging
Records robotic-assisted radical prostatectomy (RALP) operative parameters and margins
Schedules and evaluates structured follow-up checkpoints (3, 6, 12, 24, 36 months)
Monitors longitudinal PSA trends and overall department clinical outcomes

cards.title: Patient PROMs Story
items: Patient securely accesses digital assessment portal via authenticated invite link
Completes baseline and scheduled post-operative PROMs (IPSS, SHIM, Continence)
Submits real-time symptom scores without requiring in-clinic paper forms
Automatic notifications flag severe urinary or erectile distress to clinical team

cards.title: AI Ingestion & Review Story
items: Clinician uploads histology report PDFs or operative DOCX files in batch
OCR and Mammoth.js text parsing extract Gleason grade, lymph nodes, and margins
Automated fuzzy matching maps extracted records directly to patient records
Uncertain or contradictory entries enter the Review Queue for manual clinician sign-off

cards.title: Data Manager / Admin Story
items: Admin governs role-based permissions across Clinicians, Data Managers, and Patients
Audits system access logs, record revisions, and patient data modifications
Monitors data completeness scorecards and resolves missing clinical fields
Exports de-identified structured datasets in CSV format for research and registries
